import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Data Preprocessing - convert text to strings
train_df["text"] = train_df["text"].astype(str)
test_df["text"] = train_df["text"].astype(str)

# Define Author Mapping (critical for label conversion)
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
inverse_map = {0: "EAP", 1: "HPL", 2: "MWS"}

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

# 1. Validation Phase - Stratified hold-out to estimate performance
# NEVER use validation data for training
val_ratio = 0.15
X_train_texts = train_df["text"].values
y_train_labels = train_df["author"].map(author_map).values

# Split training data into train and validation sets (stratified)
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_labels = train_test_split(
    X_train_texts,
    y_train_labels,
    test_size=val_ratio,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_labels,
)

print(f"Training for validation: {len(X_train_split)} samples")
print(f"Validation for validation: {len(X_val_split)} samples")

# Vectorizers - AGGRESSIVE FEATURE FILTERING from solution_v3 to fit time budget
# Use min_df to filter rare terms, max_df to filter too common terms
vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 3),
    lowercase=True,
    norm="l2",
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.95,
)
vectorizer_word_uni = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 1),
    lowercase=True,
    norm="l2",
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.95,
)
vectorizer_word_bi = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(2, 2),
    lowercase=True,
    norm="l2",
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.95,
)

# Fit vectorizers on training split only (no leakage from validation)
X_train_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_char = vectorizer_char.transform(X_val_split)

X_train_uni = vectorizer_word_uni.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_uni = vectorizer_word_uni.transform(X_val_split)

X_train_bi = vectorizer_word_bi.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_bi = vectorizer_word_bi.transform(X_val_split)

# Combine features: char + word_uni + word_bi (concatenate along feature axis)
X_train_vec = np.hstack(
    [X_train_char.toarray(), X_train_uni.toarray(), X_train_bi.toarray()]
)
X_val_vec = np.hstack([X_val_char.toarray(), X_val_uni.toarray(), X_val_bi.toarray()])

print(
    f"Feature dimensions - Char: {X_train_char.shape[1]}, "
    f"WordUni: {X_train_uni.shape[1]}, WordBi: {X_train_bi.shape[1]}, "
    f"Total: {X_train_vec.shape[1]}"
)

# Train SINGLE Logistic Regression model (solution_v3 simplified from ensemble)
print("\nTraining single Logistic Regression model on validation set...")
model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42, C=1.0, n_jobs=1
)
model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_split)
pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)
pred_clamped = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val_labels, pred_clamped, labels=[0, 1, 2])
print(f"  Validation log loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

final_val_log_loss = val_log_loss

# 2. Submission Phase - Retrain on full training data for best performance
print("\nRetraining model on full training data for submission...")

X_full_train = train_df["text"]
X_test_texts = test_df["text"]

# Fit vectorizers on full training text (for submission) - same parameters as validation
submit_vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 3),
    lowercase=True,
    norm="l2",
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.95,
)
submit_vectorizer_word_uni = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 1),
    lowercase=True,
    norm="l2",
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.95,
)
submit_vectorizer_word_bi = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(2, 2),
    lowercase=True,
    norm="l2",
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.95,
)

X_full_train_char = submit_vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_full_train)
X_test_char = submit_vectorizer_char.transform(X_test_texts)

X_full_train_uni = submit_vectorizer_word_uni.fit_transform(X_full_train)
X_test_uni = submit_vectorizer_word_uni.transform(X_test_texts)

X_full_train_bi = submit_vectorizer_word_bi.fit_transform(X_full_train)
X_test_bi = submit_vectorizer_word_bi.transform(X_test_texts)

X_full_train_vec = np.hstack(
    [X_full_train_char.toarray(), X_full_train_uni.toarray(), X_full_train_bi.toarray()]
)
X_test_vec = np.hstack(
    [X_test_char.toarray(), X_test_uni.toarray(), X_test_bi.toarray()]
)

# Train single model on full training data (previously timed out with ensemble)
submit_model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42, C=1.0, n_jobs=1
)
submit_model.fit(X_full_train_vec, y_train_labels)

# Generate predictions on test set
final_pred = submit_model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Numerical stability clamping (prevent log(0))
final_pred_clamped = np.clip(final_pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission DataFrame
# Column order must match: id, EAP, HPL, MWS
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": final_pred_clamped[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_pred_clamped[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_pred_clamped[:, 2],
    }
)

# Verify submission structure
print(f"\nSubmission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission)}")
print(f"Column order: {list(submission.columns)}")

# Save submission to required path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

print(f"Validation log loss: {final_val_log_loss:.6f}")
